answer_1.quote: We frame this as a summarisation task, where, provided with elaborate fact checking reports, later referred to as ruling comments, the model has to generate veracity explanations close to the human justifications...
answer_1.outputs: veracity explanations (short textual justifications) generated from ruling comments

answer_2.quote: We present the results of the veracity explanation generation task. The results are ROUGE-N F1 scores of the generated explanation w.r.t. the gold justification...

answer_4.quote: We first provide a manual evaluation of the properties of three different types of explanations... We ask three annotators to rank these explanations... In the second manual evaluation task, we study how well the veracity explanations manage to address the information need of the user... annotators have to provide a veracity label for a claim based on a veracity explanation...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rank explanations according to Coverage, Non‑redundancy, Non‑contradiction, and Overall quality; and to assign a veracity label (binary or six‑class) based on the explanation.
